method: Actual Unity BakeMesh hand triangles sampled at15 barycentric positions each. At each point, cast a physical radial ray from the actual mounted weapon axis into its actual attached mesh triangles (two-sided first positive Moller-Trumbore hit), at that point axial coordinate. Report signed radial surface gap, not marker distance.
limits: Finite surface sampling does not prove continuous collision freedom or Euclidean minimum distance. Whole exported wrist includes an artificial open selection cut. The bone-proxy region masks are stated in the research note and do not replace visual anatomical inspection. No full-game runtime or other unexported poses are certified.

topologyScope.statement: Original vertex count and topology restored. No wrist subdivision or strong wrist corrective. Existing vertex streams, original75/100 records and index buffer are checked exactly.

skinWeightRuleVerification.statement: v007 weights are not identical to v006. The prior documented smooth distal right-hand correction is retained; this check verifies that exact rule and unchanged vertices outside it.

weaponMeshVariants.statement: This weapon-only mesh intentionally replaces the original right-hand skin471-face component. Original sleeve/body/left-hand triangle prefix remains exact. Original unused hand vertices and75/100 records are preserved. Newly modelled closed skin and an independently closed dark cuff use fixed geometry, with averaged source-cuff weights blending to the hand. Exact19-point seam stitching is intentionally not used.

axisClosestTriangleCriticalPoints.method: Analytic closest point to the axis in each projected hand triangle, followed by an actual prop-mesh radial ray at its interpolated axial coordinate. Additional critical-point check; not a proof for continuously varying prop profiles.
